exp: total accumulates num as it descends: 0+4 = 4, +3 = 7, +2 = 9, +1 = 10. num reaches 0 so the check fails and total prints as 10.
questions.q:
What is printed?
SET total = 0
SET num = 4
WHILE num > 0
  SET total = total + num
  SET num = num - 1
ENDWHILE
PRINT total

exp: x rises 11, 21, 31, ..., 91, 101 — each pass adds 10 while x < 100. At x = 101 the check 101 < 100 fails. The loop ran 10 times and the final x is 101.
questions.q:
What is the final value printed?
SET x = 1
WHILE x < 100
  SET x = x + 10
ENDWHILE
PRINT x

exp: n passes 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, all satisfying n >= 0, printing each before decrementing. At n = -1 the check fails and the loop stops. Output: 4 3 2 1 0.
questions.q:
What is printed?
SET n = 4
WHILE n >= 0
  PRINT n
  SET n = n - 1
ENDWHILE

exp: a starts at 0 and grows by 2 on each of the 5 passes (i = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. i = 6 fails the check, a is printed as 10.
questions.q:

SET a = 0
SET i = 1
WHILE i <= 5
